_: Katakana Traps 2 (Mansion) cue sheet (seconds on the film clock); scripts/mix.py and hf/index.html use the same numbers. Beat ids: hook, slip (SLIP, RICH, PANIC), explain (EXPLAIN, EM1, EM2), model (MODEL, Q1, Q2: the quick-fire trap card), cta (CTA, DEFL), end (E, TAP, END). TRIM = seconds of leading silence cut from each take (measured with silencedetect -40 dB).
